title: Build Semantic Incremental Transition And LLM Authoring Path
summary: Execute the approved 30-slice compiler, renderer, representative equation, constrained LLM draft, and minimal diagram loop without a second clock or renderer-owned semantics.

sourceRefs.summary: Thirty-slice proposal, expected end state, deferrals, and stop conditions.

expectedLearning: Whether KP's rich correspondence model is sufficient to deterministically compile representative equation transitions with stable identity and exact reverse sampling.
Whether one constrained semantic draft contract can generate both an equation animation and a minimal node-edge diagram without renderer-owned semantics.
allowedWork: Semantic correspondence, equation transition IR/compiler, selector-annotated KaTeX, measured token motion, shared-player integration, representative equation migrations, constrained LLM draft compilation, minimal DiagramScene/SVG adapter, focused tests, docs, and Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: A second playback clock, arbitrary CAS or target-math generation, LLM-authored DOM/pixels/keyframes, live model-provider integration, a general diagram layout engine, unrelated dashboard/export/media work, or the six deferred family promotions.
